# llms.txt for deedivinepropinfra.com

# Owner
Owner: Dee Divine Group
Website: https://deedivinepropinfra.com/

# Dee Divine PropInfra is a Gurgaon-based real estate consulting firm specializing in DDJAY (Deen Dayal Jan Awas Yojna) plots, residential properties, and verified rental listings across Delhi NCR. HARERA-verified projects, financing support, and end-to-end buying assistance.

## Sitemaps
- [XML Sitemap](https://deedivinepropinfra.com/sitemap.xml): Includes every public page intended for search engine crawling and indexing.

## Key Features
- **DDJAY Plot Advisory**: Expert guidance on Deen Dayal Jan Awas Yojna plots, eligibility, pricing, and HARERA-verified documentation.
- **Property Search**: Browse residential plots, apartments, and commercial listings across Gurgaon, Delhi, and Noida.
- **Financing Support**: Bank loan coordination and pre-approval assistance for plot and property purchases.
- **Site Visits**: Guided, transport-assisted site visits with dedicated consultants across Gurgaon sectors.
- **Rental Listings**: Verified 2BHK, 3BHK, and luxury rental options across Delhi NCR.

## Property Types
- Residential: Plots, Apartments, Independent Floors, Builder Floors.
- Plotted Development: DDJAY Plots (150-500 sq. yards) across licensed Gurgaon colonies.
- Rental: 2BHK, 3BHK, Luxury Apartments.

## About Dee Divine PropInfra
- [About Us](https://deedivinepropinfra.com/about): Company background, advisory experience, and team information in the Delhi NCR real estate market.
- [Contact Us](https://deedivinepropinfra.com/contact): Office at M3M Broadway, 22nd Floor, D Block, Sector 71, SPR Road, Gurgaon. Phone: +91-9211496111.

## Core Services
- [DDJAY Plots Overview](https://deedivinepropinfra.com/what-is-deen-dayal-jan-awas-yojna-ddjay-guide): Introduction to Deen Dayal Jan Awas Yojna, plot sizes, pricing, and why DDJAY is a preferred affordable-housing route in Gurgaon.
- [DDJAY Eligibility](https://deedivinepropinfra.com/ddjay-eligibility-and-documents-checklist): Eligibility criteria, required KYC documents, and the plot booking process.
- [DDJAY Loan & Financing Guide](https://deedivinepropinfra.com/ddjay-loan-financing-guide): Bank loan eligibility, loan-to-value ratios, and required documentation for DDJAY plot financing.
- [Property Investment in Gurgaon](https://deedivinepropinfra.com/property-investment-in-gurgaon): Advisory services, coverage areas, and consultant credentials across Delhi NCR.
- [Vassta Consultancy](https://deedivinepropinfra.com/vassta-consultancy): Property investment and real estate advisory services.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://deedivinepropinfra.com/faq): Comprehensive Q&A on DDJAY plots, HARERA compliance, buying process, and financing.

## Residential & Rental
- [Featured Projects](https://deedivinepropinfra.com/projects): Residential apartments and independent floors across Gurgaon, Delhi, and Noida.

## Legal & Compliance
- All listed projects are cross-verified against the Haryana Real Estate Regulatory Authority (HARERA) database before publication.
- Dee Divine PropInfra does not guarantee investment returns; appreciation figures referenced are based on historical market trends and are subject to change.
